findings.title: pathPay and swap accept destMin or sendMax of "0" or "" as a valid slippage bound
submitWithFeeIncrease has no fee ceiling unless the caller passes maxFee, and resubmits with a new sequence each time
SEP-10 memo is interpolated unencoded into the challenge URL, bypassing the memo and client_domain checks
SEP-7 tx URI selects the signing network via its network_passphrase parameter
A caller-supplied timebounds object with maxTime 0 yields a transaction with no expiry
Recovery server's returned signer key is installed on the account without validation
Sep10.sign signs an anchor challenge without checking that its client account is accountKp
DefaultSigner and DomainSigner add the client signature without checking the transaction's account
Error-data helper serialises the whole axios request, including the Authorization bearer token
SEP-10 bearer token sent to a transfer server taken unchecked from stellar.toml
SEP-12 KYC server taken from stellar.toml receives the SEP-10 bearer token without an origin check
SEP-38 bearer token is sent to whichever quote host stellar.toml names
Submit retry after a 504 that landed reports a sequence error, inviting a rebuild that pays twice
Binary SEP-9 uploads send a JSON body under a multipart Content-Type
Fee increase feeds the total fee back in as a per-operation base fee, so retries grow fees by the operation count
Account merge and signer or threshold operations are exposed by the builder without any guard
SEP-7 signature check strips the signature by substring replace, so a split parameter verifies while its parsed value is unsigned
Local SEP-10 header signer honours caller-supplied exp with no maximum lifetime
SigningKeypair exposes the account seed through a public getter and keeps it in a plain property
Payment destination is not fixed, allowlisted or bound to the caller
Withdrawal pays the caller's asset with the anchor's amount without checking amount_in_asset
Sep24 extraFields are spread last and can silently override account, asset_code and lang
SEP-6 deposit and withdraw send a caller-supplied account with the token of another account
getHistory checks only the upper bound of limit
createKeypairFromRandom accepts caller-chosen seed bytes with no entropy check
fundTestnetAccount interpolates the address into the friendbot URL without encoding or a network check
build() re-adds every queued operation on each call, so a second build duplicates payments
Recovery-server signature is attached without verifying it against the transaction
SEP-24 info cache ignores the requested language and stores unvalidated responses
SEP-6 info builds the query string from an unencoded lang parameter
Remote signer response without a token is returned as undefined and the SEP-10 request goes out with no auth header
getServicesInfo builds its URL from an unchecked TOML field and an unencoded lang
sep7ReplacementsToString drops a replacement whose id is __proto__, producing an unparseable replace string
Sponsored createAccount converts startingBalance with Number.toString() and no bounds check
Sep7Pay exposes asset_code without requiring or checking asset_issuer
Sep7Pay amount getter returns unvalidated query text
Sep7Pay memoType getter casts unchecked query text to MemoType
Sep7Pay.forDestination and destination setter accept any string as a destination
update() lets sep9Info keys override explicit id, memo and transaction_id
Error helper throws a TypeError when stringifying a circular Node request object
parseToml throws on non-array or null PRINCIPALS, CURRENCIES or VALIDATORS entries, aborting anchor sep1 and challenge parsing
StellarConfiguration accepts a network passphrase and a Horizon URL that do not match
Key collisions after snake_case conversion silently overwrite fields
submitWithFeeIncrease does not serialize sequence numbers, so parallel calls on one source account fail with tx_bad_seq
Builder can emit master-key lock with no reachable signer set or thresholds, permanently locking the account
parseToml dereferences DOCUMENTATION without a guard, so a stellar.toml without that table throws
SEP-24 supported-asset check compares asset code only, not issuer
SEP-10 JWT is accepted without signature verification or account binding
Sep12.delete sends the agent's SEP-10 token to delete any account's KYC record
getQuote interpolates quoteId into the URL path without encoding or validation
Sep12.delete interpolates the account address into the URL path without encoding
Anchor home domain accepts any host, including internal addresses, with no private-address filter
SEP-24 supported-asset check compares asset code only, not issuer
Fee bump and transaction fees are passed through without a ceiling
SEP-7 URI network_passphrase is accepted as the validation network, not checked against the agent's configured network
